description: Smart transfer: one call for any destination. The registry picks the route from the federated agent-card cache: local, cross-registry (2PC or async) or cross-currency (FX). Set dry_run=true to preview the route decision without moving anything. This tool sends no idempotency key: before retrying a call that timed out, check getMyTegTransactions. Requires agent JWT.

amount.description: Amount in the SENDER frame's currency (numeric string, e.g. '2.5')

backend.description: Optional same-currency remote backend hint: '2pc' (default, sync) or 'async' (locked then settled). Ignored for local and FX routes.

dry_run.description: Preview the route decision; move nothing

receiver_did.description: DID of the receiving agent, local or federated

name: theprotocol_smartSend
title: Smart Send (auto-routing transfer)
